snippet.title: Age of Empires II: DE - Chronicles: Alexander the Great | Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Coming October 14th, 2025 - Prepare for the next chapter in the fan-favorite Chronicles saga by stepping into the sandals of history’s greatest conqueror. Embark on a sweeping, narrative-driven campaign that traces Alexander the Great’s rise from precocious youth to world-shaking ruler as you command your Macedonian phalanx, strike into the heart of Persia, and carve a path through South Asia in an adventure unlike any other.

Audio Description: https://youtu.be/-3gTnrXQGYg
